design_concept: Editorial Noir / Cinematic Control Room. High-contrast, desaturated dark tones with striking structural typography, creating a 'film director's console' experience. Zero generic AI-slop gradients.

rules: H1 (Hero): Cabinet Grotesk, font-black, tracking-tighter, uppercase. Clamp size up to text-6xl.
H2/H3 (Artistic moments/Quotes/Taglines): Cormorant Garamond, font-italic, tracking-tight. text-3xl to text-4xl.
UI Body/Data: Manrope, font-light or font-regular, tracking-normal. text-sm to text-base.
Labels/Overlines/Badges: IBM Plex Mono, uppercase, tracking-[0.2em], text-xs.
NEVER use generic fonts (Inter, Roboto) for headings.
Hierarchy Gap Rule: Never jump more than 2 Tailwind steps between headings and subheadings.
Avoid pure black (#000000) for large backgrounds; use #0A0A0A to reduce eye fatigue.
Desaturate accent colors to prevent chemical vibrancy glare on OLED screens.
Gradients are strictly forbidden unless used as subtle dark noise overlays or 10% opacity masks.
Borders should be 1px solid, low opacity (border-white/10) to separate surfaces cleanly.

textures: Subtle noise overlay (opacity 2-3%) across the entire app background to kill digital flatness and emulate film grain.
surfaces: Glassmorphism (Headers/Sticky Nav): bg-black/60, backdrop-blur-xl, border-b border-white/10.
Grid Borders (Dashboard/Workflow): Expose the grid. Use border-collapse style layouts with border-r border-b border-white/10 for a technical storyboard look.
shadows: Cinematic Glow: drop-shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(229,184,59,0.15)] for primary active elements.
Elevation: shadow-2xl with black/80 for floating panels or modals.

spacing_system: Use massive padding (p-12, p-16, p-24) on the landing page for 'breathing room'.
Dense, tight spacing (p-4, gap-4) in the Dashboard and Project Results Workflow for a high-utility control room feel.
Always add internal padding to containers with borders to prevent text collision.
grid_patterns: Bento Grid Mode A (Landing Page): grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12, wide gaps (gap-8), high asymmetry. Hero image spans col-span-8.
High Density Grid Mode B (Workflow Page): grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4, tight gaps (gap-4). Timeline/Nav on col-span-1, content on col-span-3.

page_structures.landing_page: Immersive hero section with max overlay opacity bg-black/50, offset typography, and a staggered feature cards bento grid.
page_structures.project_workflow: Split layout. Left sidebar: Vertical linear progress/timeline showing gated stages. Right side: Dense workspace for assets, scenes, and storyboard builders.

components.cards: Modern cards with sharp corners (rounded-none or max rounded-sm), flat background (#121212), 1px subtle border (#262626). No heavy drop shadows; rely on borders for definition.
components.badges: Pill-shaped, transparent background, 1px bright border based on status, mono font, uppercase, text-xs.
components.buttons: Sharp or slightly rounded (rounded-sm). Primary CTA uses the Brand Accent (Cinematic Gold) with black text. Hover state explicitly defined with color shift and slight scale (active:scale-95).
components.inputs_forms: Use customized Shadcn UI components. Dark inputs (bg-#0F0F0F), border-white/10, focus:border-brand-accent/50, focus:ring-1.
components.navigation: Visible top nav on desktop. Glassmorphic background. Links use Manrope, uppercase, tracking-widest.

motion.transitions: Specific property transitions only (e.g., transition-colors duration-300, transition-transform). NO 'transition-all'.
motion.interactions: Hover states must increase lightness/contrast. Cards lift slightly (-translate-y-1) with border color change.
motion.page_load: Staggered fade-in and slide-up (framer-motion) for dashboard lists and storyboard scenes.

accessibility.contrast: Text must pass WCAG AA (4.5:1). Use APCA guidelines for dark mode readability.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='new-project-btn').

images.description: Warm, dramatic concert stage lights piercing through darkness. Perfect for the 'Every Song Has a World' tagline.
Hand-drawn storyboard/wireframe sketches. Use in the Feature Cards or Project Workflow empty states.

images.category: Music Video Behind The Scenes / Creator Mode
images.description: Man holding a high-end cinema camera glowing with red light in a dark studio. Emphasizes the 'Creative Director' persona.
Woman illuminated by a striking neon halo against black. Use as a 'Scene Image Prompt' or generated asset example.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a 'hybrid_fullstack' React application using Tailwind CSS and Framer Motion.
Implement the pages: Landing, Dashboard, Create Project, Project Results Workflow, and Settings.
The Project Results Workflow must feature an approval-gated linear progression UI (e.g., locking 'Scene Images' until 'Visual World Report' is approved).
Strictly adhere to the typography pairings: Cabinet Grotesk (Main Impact), Cormorant Garamond (Poetic hooks/Quotes), Manrope (UI), and IBM Plex Mono (Badges/Status).
Do NOT use HTML native date pickers, selects, or dialogs. Use customized Shadcn primitives adapted to the dark cinematic theme.
Apply a global CSS film grain/noise overlay using a repeating radial gradient or SVG noise pattern to the body background.
Ensure all buttons and inputs have robust hover and focus states.
Integrate the provided images securely without using generic placeholders.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and 1px borders.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for sticky navs and floating panels.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, i.e., do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles (sharp or slightly rounded) with interaction animations & brand-relevant colors.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for icons. Use lucide-react.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable on marketing sections. Cramped designs look cheap.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use sonner for toast notifications, located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx.
